`studio.hdr`: [Studio Small 09](https://polyhaven.com/a/studio_small_09) by Sergej Majboroda,
Poly Haven, [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
Relit as a jewelry "light tent": an even white dome (+1.6) over the sky, fading out over the
last 30° above the horizon, plus +0.2 overall fill, keeping the studio's softbox highlights.
Diamonds gather light from above the viewer; under the original dark ceiling they render
physically dark.
